method: GitHub Actions REST API. Failed runs of the CI and Mobile CI workflows were listed: the 200 failed pull_request runs (2026-03-15 .. 2026-11-20) and the 66 failed push runs on main; the unrelated Deploy, Deploy Health Check, Production * and EAS workflows are excluded; for each, GET /actions/runs/{id}/jobs gave the jobs whose conclusion was "failure" (the aggregate "CI Gate" is excluded because it only mirrors them); GET /compare/main...{head_sha} (pull_request) or GET /commits/{sha} (push) gave the changed files. Nothing was invented or hand-edited. Where the baseline itself had no completed CI run, up to three first-parent ancestors were tried (baseline.status known_via_ancestor, with the distance); if none had a run the baseline stays unknown and all failed jobs are kept.
inclusion_rule: Every distinct head SHA with at least one failed non-gate job, a retrievable file list and at most 80 changed files (SHAs with larger diffs, and runs whose file list was unavailable, are excluded). Dependency-only diffs with an identical (file set, failed jobs) signature are collapsed into one entry whose `duplicates` counts the repeats. No entry was dropped for its outcome.
caveats: The file list is the cumulative branch diff GitHub reports at mining time; it can differ from the diff CI saw if main moved or the branch was rewritten.
A failed job is real CI evidence for that SHA but not proof the diff caused it (environment-dependent jobs such as Room-Board Pixel-Diff fail independently of file content).
inherited_failed_jobs are real CI failures on that SHA but pre-date the diff; recall is scored on failed_jobs (introduced) and, separately, including inherited ones.
